column7: POOLER-LOCKLOSS-1 "Not changed": admin backup writes its archive in place (O_EXCL). On the exclusive path (SQLite, --exclusive) a lost lock stopped the command with os.Exit from stopOnLostDatabaseLock, skipping every defer, so the partial archive stayed on disk; and with an unwatched SQLite lock the backup simply finished. A loss between the live path's last check and the close was also missed. Now the archive's removal is registered with onLostDatabaseLock before the first byte and runs before the exit, writes stop and reads are cancelled on either lock's Lost, and the lock is checked again after the close; the error says the backup is not usable. Three points (before the first byte, mid-stream, after the last byte before close) for both lock kinds; the live PostgreSQL table is TestAdminBackup_Postgres_LivePresenceLost_NoArchiveAndNonZeroExit (pg-gated), and TestAdminBackup_SQLiteLockLostMidStream_RemovesTheArchive shows the archive is gone when the command is stopped.
